responses.name: Hosting: All set
responses.body:
Hi [First Name],

Good to see you're in. We've taken our setup account off your ITFlow, so every seat is yours. We're resolving this ticket now - for anything else, reply here or email us any time.

Your invoices are in our client portal each month, where you can also save a card so they're paid by themselves.

Welcome to hosted ITFlow.

  • Address: [Hostname]

  • Region: [Region]
  • Each month: [Monthly]

[What to check]

Just reply here - and if anything needs changing, more technicians or a different address, tell us before you pay and we'll send a new invoice.

responses.name: Hosting: DNS record to add
responses.body:
Hi [First Name],

To use [Hostname], add this record where your domain's DNS is managed:

TypeA
Name[Hostname] - some DNS panels want only the first part
Value[Server IP]
TTLAutomatic, or 3600

Reply here once it's in. As soon as it resolves we put the certificate on it and finish setting up your ITFlow.

responses.name: Hosting: Your ITFlow is ready
responses.body:
Hi [First Name],

Your ITFlow is ready at https://[Hostname].

1. Accept your invite. Open this link, choose your password and sign in - it works for 7 days:
[Invite link]

2. Connect your mail. In Admin > Mail, set up sending - and receiving, for email to tickets - with your own mail server, Microsoft 365 or Google. ITFlow sends nothing until you do: no invites, no ticket emails, no invoices. The steps are at https://docs.itflow.org/admin/mail

3. Invite your team. In Admin > Users, New User. You have [Technicians] technician seats - clients and their portal contacts are free.

We keep it up to date and back it up every night. Anything you need, just reply here.
